Hisotry:Nicole is a seventeen-year-old American girl with severe sociopathic tendencies, which she's quite proud of. She's the youngest member of her family, living with her NEET older brother who was charged for piracy, and mother who abuses prescription drugs. Nicole constantly transfers schools due to her mother's marital issues, though she rarely attends her classes anyway. She keeps to herself and will insult anyone who even attempts to befriend her. Her actions are always either harshly self-serving or dangerously manipulative, and she unconsciously views everything in a pessimistic light; she's depressed with a history of minor self-harm. Nicole has long brown hair that she wears in a straight ponytail. She has blue eyes and is incredibly beautiful; a fact she takes advantage of by stringing older men on for expensive gifts. She has a slim figure, although her breasts are larger than that of the average high schooler. She prefers to wear 2010s era emo and scene clothes. Nicole has a mild hatred for men; after she discovered her father's corpse in her childhood and the fact that he blamed her on his suicide note, she's held the strong belief that all men are secretly evil ever since.(though that doesn't mean Nicole hates her dad,she despise what he did,but never hate him and kinda miss him and wanna know why is her fault and sometimes cries for her father.)
Nicole's view on women is slightly nicer; women are all victims of male power and those trying to align with their oppressors aren't deserving of respect. Despite her odd morals, she can't really be described as having a rude personality in most situations; she's simply cold, and could actually be described as rather chill. She's desensitized to things such as crude language, dark humor, being shot, and various recreational drugs.Nicole is exceptionally witty and intelligent, capable of destroying somebody's self-confidence on the spot. Despite this, she possesses some form of moral code, though it is pretty self-centered and selective. She often expresses her hatred for pedophiles, sexual harassers and rapists. Nicole's best and only friend is Jecka.
